tools.name: focus
tools.description: Set this operator's write focus: the knowledge area new memories are stored under, and optionally the project being worked on. The wake card's chips call this; it is also callable directly. Holds until changed or idle past the TTL; explicit area/project args on commit/note/handoff still win.

tools.name: presence
tools.description: Read live Lady Whiskerdown facet presence within the requested window.

tools.name: systems
tools.description: Ask the business systems Kit is connected to (accounting, HR, a shop) live: its own and those of Kits linked to it. Kit's memories hold the history, decisions and who owns what; a system holds today's records. For a question about a customer, a person or an order, recall first, then ask the system f

tools.name: ranking_compare
tools.description: Compare search ranking for a query with and without the recently learned boost. Returns every row whose rank or score changes, with baseline rank, boosted rank, position delta, score delta, sample source, boost window, and units.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search Lady Whiskerdown's archive. Use it first for anything Lady Whiskerdown should know. Returns the most relevant entries this key can read; cite each one you use as (Lady Whiskerdown, m#N) with its title.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Read a single Lady Whiskerdown memory by id (as returned by recall). No graph or entity enrichment: the receiver endpoint returns the memory itself, scoped to this key.

tools.name: areas
tools.description: List the knowledge areas in this Lady Whiskerdown.

tools.name: wake
tools.description: Open Lady Whiskerdown, an archive you can question. Call this first in every new chat (VS Code/Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex), before the first substantive answer. It returns what Lady Whiskerdown is (`you_are`), which knowledge areas this key can see, which tools this key may use, and any rul

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "recall" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
